name: v28-40-local-judge-uncalibrated
objective: Plan 14: a judge use routed to the local provider (systemone-local, empty readiness table) or to llama-logprob (rows measured and failed) is refused as uncalibrated BEFORE any transport: no request to the judge plugin (not even /status) leaves the page during the ask, the call ring records fallback uncalibrated with the provider, and the journal says so. Control: the same ask on the default TypeSafe route reaches the status probe and falls back unavailable (no plugin on this lane), so the counter can see a request. The routing is visible in the Connections > Judge settings readiness rows (not calibrated there / measured there and refused) and the local judge status line. Settings are restored. No TypeSafe key, no plugin, no model.

requires.why: Routing refusal and settings UI only; the lane has no judge plugin and no key.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const root = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings ??= {}; const original = globalThis.fetch; const hits = []; globalThis.__j40 = { hadJudge: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(root.settings, 'judge'), judge: root.settings.judge === undefined ? undefined : structuredClone(root.settings.judge), original, hits, author: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().ui?.authorView ?? false }; globalThis.fetch = function (input, init) { const url = String(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? input); if (url.includes('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge')) hits.push(url.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/, '')); return original.apply(this, arguments); }; const judge = root.settings.judge ?? {}; root.settings.judge = { ...judge, enabled: true, uses: { ...(judge.uses ?? {}), director: true, stallCheck: true }, provider: { ...(judge.provider ?? {}), director: 'systemone-local', stallCheck: 'llama-logprob' } }; const eff = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge; if (!eff.enabled || eff.provider.director !== 'systemone-local' || eff.provider.stallCheck !== 'llama-logprob') throw new Error('routing not effective: ' + JSON.stringify(eff.provider)); return { director: eff.provider.director, stallCheck: eff.provider.stallCheck };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const w = globalThis.__j40; const judge = rt.getJudge(); globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); const request = { state: { scene: 'SO-J40 synthetic hall' }, questions: { q: { type: 'noul', instructions: 'Is the hall quiet?' } } }; const out = {}; for (const use of ['director', 'stall']) { const before = w.hits.length; const answer = await judge.ask(use, request); out[use] = { fallback: answer.fallback, answers: answer.answers, latencyMs: answer.latencyMs, transport: w.hits.slice(before) }; } if (out.director.fallback !== 'uncalibrated' || out.director.answers !== null || out.director.transport.length) throw new Error('local route not refused before transport: ' + JSON.stringify(out.director)); if (out.stall.fallback !== 'uncalibrated' || out.stall.answers !== null || out.stall.transport.length) throw new Error('llama-logprob route not refused before transport: ' + JSON.stringify(out.stall)); const calls = rt.getSnapshot().judgeCalls ?? rt.extras?.judge?.calls ?? []; const ring = calls.slice(-2).map((c) => ({ use: c.use, fallback: c.fallback, provider: c.provider ?? null, model: c.model })); if (!ring.some((c) => c.use === 'director' && c.fallback === 'uncalibrated' && c.provider === 'systemone-local') || !ring.some((c) => c.use === 'stall' && c.fallback === 'uncalibrated' && c.provider === 'llama-logprob')) throw new Error('call ring lacks the refusals: ' + JSON.stringify(ring)); const journal = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((e) => e.kind === 'judge' && /uncalibrated/.test(e.summary)).map((e) => e.summary); if (journal.length < 2) throw new Error('journal lacks the refusals: ' + JSON.stringify(journal)); w.refusals = { out, ring, journal }; return w.refusals;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const w = globalThis.__j40; const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, provider: { ...root.settings.judge.provider, director: 'typesafe' } }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); const before = w.hits.length; const answer = await rt.getJudge().ask('director', { state: { scene: 'SO-J40 control' }, questions: { q: { type: 'noul', instructions: 'Is the hall quiet?' } } }); const transport = w.hits.slice(before); if (answer.fallback !== 'unavailable' || !transport.some((url) => url.endsWith('/status'))) throw new Error('control: the default route should reach the status probe and fall back unavailable: ' + JSON.stringify({ fallback: answer.fallback, transport })); root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, provider: { ...root.settings.judge.provider, director: 'systemone-local' } }; return { control: answer.fallback, transport };

const click = (sel) => { const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (!el) throw new Error('missing ' + sel); el.click(); }; click('#so-workspace-page-connections'); const until = Date.now() + 10000; while (!document.querySelector('#so-area-judge') && Date.now() < until) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const area = document.querySelector('#so-area-judge'); if (!area) throw new Error('judge area missing on Connections'); if (!area.open) area.querySelector('summary').click(); const text = () => document.querySelector('#so-judge-readiness')?.textContent ?? ''; const local = () => document.querySelector('#so-judge-local-systemone-local')?.textContent ?? ''; while ((!text().includes('not calibrated there') || !local()) && Date.now() < until + 10000) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const rows = text(); if (!/routed to Local judge \(this machine\), not calibrated there/.test(rows)) throw new Error('readiness row for the local route missing: ' + rows); if (!rows.includes('measured there and refused')) throw new Error('readiness row for the refused llama-logprob route missing: ' + rows); if (!/not ready/.test(local())) throw new Error('local judge status line missing: ' + local()); return { readiness: rows.slice(0, 600), local: local().slice(0, 300) };

const w = globalThis.__j40; const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; globalThis.fetch = w.original; if (w.hadJudge) root.settings.judge = w.judge; else delete root.settings.judge; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: w.author }); const eff = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge; if (eff.provider.director !== 'typesafe' || eff.provider.stallCheck !== 'typesafe') throw new Error('routing not restored: ' + JSON.stringify(eff.provider)); delete globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse; return { restored: true, enabled: eff.enabled, pluginRequests: w.hits.length };

const w = globalThis.__j40; if (w) { const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; if (globalThis.fetch !== w.original) globalThis.fetch = w.original; if (w.hadJudge) root.settings.judge = w.judge; else delete root.settings.judge; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: w.author }); } return true;
